new_recommendations.name: Madison Hall
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: I had the opportunity to take one of Madison's classes while visiting Middleton and was really impressed. She's welcoming, knowledgeable,and creates a positive environment that makes everyone feel comfortable. Thanks Madison!

new_recommendations.name: Steph Nash
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: Steph is an amazing fitness instructor at Shred 415 in Naperville. She always has great music makes, makes class fun and is very energetic and motivating!

new_recommendations.name: Chris Cundari
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: Chris is one of the best fitness trainers I known. he has an excellent knowledge and understanding of the human body.

new_recommendations.name: Laila Hana
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: I went to Bare in Naperville and wow what a class! Laila had a great vibe and energy. awesome music. kicks your butt but makes it fun. thank you!
new_recommendations.note: Jim confirmed that his recommendation describes Laila’s class at barre3 Naperville. Original quote wording preserved.

new_recommendations.name: Heather McCarthy
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: Heather is fantastic! Great energy, great music, and knows exactly how to motivate you while kicking your butt and keeping you smiling😀

new_recommendations.name: Amanda Roszkowski
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: Amanda is an amazing yoga instructor at YogaSix DG. Her classes are challenging, fun, and always have a great flow. Highly recommend taking a class with her!
new_recommendations.note: This recommendation describes Jim’s YogaSix Downers Grove experience when posted in August 2026. Check the studio’s current schedule for teaching availability.

new_recommendations.name: Ashley
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: Ashley is a big reason I love Shred415 Naperville! She brings amazing energy, makes every class fun, and keeps you motivated to push yourself. If you’re looking for an instructor who makes you excited to show up and work hard, take her class!

new_recommendations.name: Marlissa Hamgeri
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: Loved Marlissa’s class! Great experienced instructor, challenging workout, and she made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in to the beautiful studio. She kept the class moving and fun. Definitely coming back for another class!

new_recommendations.name: Kristen Richter
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.note: Shown in Jim’s original wording. His recommendation does not identify a studio or class format; see Kristen’s profile and live studio schedules for her Lagree teaching.

new_recommendations.name: Erika James
new_recommendations.author: Amy Cohn Rieselman
new_recommendations.quote: I love Erika’s Saturday @9 Saha Flow. It’s different every time as far as what we stretch, then her flow is almost always the same going through the warriors, and other asanas to build leg strength. She plays bowls during Savasana. I always feel invigorated and happy after!
new_recommendations.note: Amy described the class she attended in November 2026. Confirm current days, times, and teachers on Saha’s live schedule.

new_recommendations.name: Claudine Beeson
new_recommendations.author: Amy Cohn Rieselman
new_recommendations.quote: Claudine is so talented and masterful as a yoga teacher. Expect fun, challenge, and something new every class. People seek her out. I feel blessed to be her student!
new_recommendations.note: A recommendation for Claudine’s teaching; the original does not name a studio.

new_recommendations.name: Sue L
new_recommendations.author: Jim
new_recommendations.quote: Sue is a fantastic instructor that always brings a smile and positive attitude to class.
